name: HideYoApes
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: @HideYoApes previously owned several expensive NFTs from Yuga Labs, including a Bored Ape, Mutant Ape, three Bored Ape Kennel Club NFTs, a SewerPass, and two Otherdeeds. The attacker sold all the NFTs for a profit of 127.3 wETH (~$208,000). HideYoApes explained on Twitter that he had downloaded and installed the MetaMask wallet extension from MetaMask’s official website.
